title: A page database write never opens a permission card in a cloud session
why: R21, owner 19:01 CST Nov 10: "ive found repos in cloud sessions of triage of repos requesting for me to permit this when it should just always be allowed this needs to be fixed too". The card reads "Allow Claude to use db write (claude-artifacts)?". settings.json permissions.allow on main 2d6f67f7c already holds mcp__claude-artifacts__db_write and the other db tools, yet the card shows. Cause unproven: the cloud tool is named ArtifactData and no entry names it, or auto mode asks despite the entry. Owner 19:04 CST: "claude also added new artifact commands that start with db (surf the web) that im guessing we need to add too now to the allow list". ArtifactData has nine actions (get, list, query, profiles, set, update, str_replace, delete, batch); settings.json allows six mcp__claude-artifacts__ tools. Lane: reproduce the card in a cloud session first; read the real tool names from that session's tool listing, never a guess; allow every page database action under each name the card checks; a test proves no card. call_judge.py and guard.py still judge each page write. It stalls triage itself, so it may go before R13.
source: retrospective session relay 19:03 and 19:05 CST Nov 10 (R21); plan restart-plan stage 3.12, commits 72bcfdb and 74ce03e
